title: Sunday Lunch for Nine (Possibly Ten)

pre.en: What was really wrong with Sue's oven?
pre.zh: Sue 的烤箱到底出了什么毛病？
options: It hadn't been used since Easter.
Nothing — it was switched off at the wall.
It was too small for ten people.

intro: 一段家庭群聊：周六晚上八点，Tom 的妈妈 Sue 张罗第二天的周日午餐，问题一个接一个冒出来。群聊里每条消息都很口语，还有互相拆台的玩笑。读的时候留意进行时的被动：is being repaired、is being used，说某件事「正在被做」或已经安排好「要被做」。

sentences.en: Right, everyone: lunch is served at one on Sunday, and roast beef is on the menu.
sentences.zh: 好了各位：周日一点开饭，主菜是烤牛肉。
sentences.speaker: Sue

sentences.en: That's nine of us, including Gran, Rosie and Chen, Tom's friend from work.
sentences.zh: 一共九个人，包括奶奶、Rosie，还有 Tom 的同事小陈。

sentences.en: Mum, he's my flatmate.
sentences.zh: 妈，他是我室友。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: And he's in this chat.
sentences.zh: 而且他就在这个群里。

sentences.en: Hi everyone, and thanks for having me!
sentences.zh: 大家好，谢谢你们请我来！
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: If you need a hand in the kitchen, count me in.
sentences.zh: 厨房要是缺人手，算我一个。

sentences.en: Small problem: my oven isn't working, and it's being repaired tomorrow between ten and one.
sentences.zh: 有个小问题：我的烤箱坏了，明天十点到一点之间有人来修。
sentences.speaker: Sue

sentences.en: The beef has to be cooked for at least two hours, so I've no idea how this is going to work.
sentences.zh: 牛肉至少得烤两个小时，我真不知道这下该怎么弄。

sentences.en: Also, the big table is being used at the moment.
sentences.zh: 还有，那张大桌子现在正占着呢。
sentences.speaker: Pete

sentences.en: I'm painting the garden chairs on it, but I'll move them tomorrow to free up some space.
sentences.zh: 我在上面刷花园的椅子，明天挪走，腾点地方出来。

sentences.en: Can I bring Jake along?
sentences.zh: 我能带 Jake 一起来吗？
sentences.speaker: Rosie

sentences.en: He's vegetarian, though.
sentences.zh: 不过他吃素。

sentences.en: He's giving a presentation in Leeds that morning, so he might be a bit late.
sentences.zh: 他那天上午要在利兹做个报告，可能会晚一点到。

sentences.en: And please don't bring up the vegetarian thing in front of Gran.
sentences.zh: 还有，千万别在奶奶面前提吃素的事。

sentences.en: She's very strict about Sunday roasts.
sentences.zh: 她对周日烤肉可讲究了。

sentences.en: Gran can read, Rosie.
sentences.zh: 奶奶认得字，Rosie。
sentences.speaker: Margaret

sentences.en: My oven hasn't been used since Easter, so the beef can be cooked at mine.
sentences.zh: 我的烤箱从复活节起就没用过，牛肉拿到我家烤吧。

sentences.en: And Chen can come round and help out.
sentences.zh: 让小陈过来搭把手。

sentences.en: Rosie, please make up your mind.
sentences.zh: Rosie，你倒是拿个主意。
sentences.speaker: Sue

sentences.en: Is Jake coming or not?
sentences.zh: Jake 到底来不来？

sentences.en: He's coming!
sentences.zh: 来！
sentences.speaker: Rosie

sentences.en: He and Chen will have a lot in common.
sentences.zh: 他和小陈肯定很聊得来。

sentences.en: They both love cooking.
sentences.zh: 两个人都爱做饭。

sentences.en: Shall I make some vegetable dumplings for Jake?
sentences.zh: 要不我给 Jake 包点素饺子？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: We haven't got enough potatoes for ten, so I'm just popping out to the shop.
sentences.zh: 土豆不够十个人吃，我这就去趟商店。
sentences.speaker: Pete

sentences.en: No worries, love.
sentences.zh: 没事没事，亲爱的。
sentences.speaker: Sue

sentences.en: Planning this lunch has dragged on all week, but we're nearly there.
sentences.zh: 这顿饭筹划了整整一个星期，总算快搞定了。

sentences.en: So, the beef is being cooked at Gran's tomorrow, and the potatoes are being bought as we speak.
sentences.zh: 那就这么定了：牛肉明天在奶奶家烤，土豆这会儿正在买。

sentences.en: Mum, that's your eleventh "no worries" since eight.
sentences.zh: 妈，从八点到现在，你已经说了十一个「没事」了。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Update: it's 12:58 on Sunday, and the oven man is finally here.
sentences.zh: 最新消息：周日 12 点 58 分，修烤箱的师傅总算来了。
sentences.speaker: Pete

sentences.en: He says the oven's fine.
sentences.zh: 他说烤箱好好的。

sentences.en: It was switched off at the wall.
sentences.zh: 是墙上的电源开关被关掉了。

cards.note: Sunday roast 是英国传统的周日午餐：烤肉、烤土豆和蔬菜，配肉汁。
available to eat at a meal or in a restaurant
cards.tip: 也能用来比喻「在计划里」：A trip to Paris isn't on the menu this year.
cards.example: Fish and chips is always on the menu on Fridays.

cards.note: used to say that you want to join an activity or plan
cards.tip: 反过来说「别算我」是 count me out；只用 me，一般不说 count him in。
cards.example: Pizza after work? Count me in!

cards.note: 英国人做饭很依赖烤箱；微波炉是 microwave。
to not know something at all
to make time, money or space available for something else
cards.tip: 宾语是代词时放中间：free it up；常见搭配 free up time / space / memory。
cards.example: Cancelling that meeting will free up my afternoon.

cards.note: to take someone or something with you when you go somewhere
cards.tip: 人或东西放在 bring 和 along 中间：bring Jake along；短的代词一定放中间：bring him along。
cards.example: Feel free to bring your partner along to the party.

cards.note: 口语常简称 veggie；完全不吃动物制品的是 vegan。
to talk to a group of people about a subject, often using slides
to start talking about a subject
cards.tip: 和这课的 bring sb along 不一样：bring up 是「提起话题」；bring up a child 是「把孩子养大」。
cards.example: Don't bring up money at dinner — Dad gets upset.

cards.note: where someone can see or hear you; in a position before someone or something
每年三四月间的节日，英国学校会放两周假；首字母大写。
to help someone, especially when they are busy
cards.tip: 比 help 更口语，常不带宾语；要说帮谁可以 help sb out。
cards.example: My sister sometimes helps out at the café on Saturdays.

cards.note: to decide something, especially after thinking about it for a long time
to share many of the same interests, opinions or experiences
包饺子说 make dumplings；英国菜里也有一种 dumpling，是面团做的团子。
复数加 es：potatoes；烤土豆 roast potatoes 是周日午餐的标配。
to leave a place for a short time
cards.tip: 英式口语，常和 just 连用；去哪里用 to，为了什么用 for：pop out for some milk。
cards.example: I'm just popping out for a coffee — back in ten minutes.

cards.note: used to say that something is not a problem, or as a reply to thanks
cards.tip: 非常口语，英国、澳大利亚常用；回答 Thank you 时也能说，相当于 You're welcome。
cards.example: "Sorry I'm late." "No worries — we haven't started yet."

cards.note: to continue for longer than you want or expect
cards.tip: 主语是事情（会议、项目），不是人；常带抱怨的口气。
cards.example: The meeting dragged on until seven.

cards.note: at the wall 指墙上的电源插座开关；英国插座多数自带开关。
